faqs.question: Do I need prior marketing experience?
faqs.answer: No. This course is designed for beginners. We start with marketing fundamentals and then layer in Gen AI tools step by step.

faqs.question: Which AI tools will we use?
faqs.answer: We use ChatGPT, Claude, and other industry-standard AI tools for content, ads, and automation. You'll get hands-on practice with prompts and workflows.

faqs.question: What is the class schedule?
faqs.answer: Live classes run 3 times per week (2 hours each) for 6 months. We offer weekday evening and weekend batches. All sessions are recorded.

faqs.question: Will I get a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. On successful completion you'll receive a TechPath certificate in Digital Marketing with Gen AI that you can share on LinkedIn.

faqs.question: Is EMI available?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer EMI options starting from ₹7,500/month so you can pay in installments.

faqs.question: What projects will I build?
faqs.answer: You'll complete an SEO content pack, a paid campaign (Meta or Google), an email/social automation project, and a capstone portfolio project with a full case study.
